patch.summary: Accelerated Growth Studio migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to Accelerated Growth Studio by inventorying legacy marketing fields, mapping them to Accelerated Growth Studio objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating critical integrations before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Services-heavy — not a classic marketing SaaS
Success signal: funnel builder works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: Accelerated Growth Studio migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power funnel builder, landing pages, marketing automation and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into Accelerated Growth Studio; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate primary integrations; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when SMBs wanting done-for-you growth support outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Services-heavy — not a classic marketing SaaS
Do not move data twice — resolve destination fit first

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire systems of record in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.
